title: 7. Left-Hand Lantern
arrangement: Original music composed for this beginner collection.
description: A Baroque-inspired role reversal: the bass carries the moving phrase.
learningFocus: A clear left-hand melody beneath sustained right-hand notes.
practiceTip: Use C–G five-finger positions. Practise the left hand alone, then make it a little louder than the held right hand.

title: 8. Mirror Steps
arrangement: Original music composed for this beginner collection.
description: An original finger study inspired by Schmitt, with opposing melodic shapes.
learningFocus: Contrary motion, coordinated attacks and independent finger directions.
practiceTip: When the right hand rises, the left often falls. Keep both hands in C position; practise one bar at a time without rushing.

title: 9. Music-Box Waltz
arrangement: Original music composed for this beginner collection.
description: A gentle Classical-style waltz with a small, repeating accompaniment.
learningFocus: Bass-and-chord accompaniment, two-note chords and dotted rhythm.
practiceTip: Count 1-and-2-and-3-and. A dotted quarter lasts 1½ beats. Play both notes of each chord together and keep beats 2 and 3 light.

title: 10. Quiet Chapel
arrangement: Original music composed for this beginner collection.
description: An original chorale-like miniature inspired by the clear harmony of Bach teaching pieces.
learningFocus: Balanced right-hand thirds over a calm bass.
practiceTip: Play RH C–E with 1–3, D–F with 2–4 and E–G with 3–5. Sound each pair together, release without tension, and count every long note.

title: 11. A Small Autumn Echo
arrangement: Original music composed for this beginner collection.
description: A quiet minor-key miniature with a folk-like, Classical character.
learningFocus: A-minor five-finger position and expressive four-bar phrases.
practiceTip: Before starting, move both hands to A–B–C–D–E: RH 1–5, LH 5–1. All notes are white keys. Let the second phrase answer the first.

title: 12. Courtyard Rondo

description: A 16-bar Classical-style rondo combining the skills of the earlier studies.
learningFocus: A returning theme, mixed rhythms and chord coordination across a longer piece.
practiceTip: Learn four bars at a time. Bars 9–12 bring back the opening theme. Keep the bass quiet and wait for the full value of long notes.
